highlights: Excluding the items described under “Net Income – Excluding Items” in the table below, Southern Company earned $2.2 billion, or $1.94 per share, during the third quarter of 2026, compared with $1.8 billion, or $1.60 per share, during the third quarter of 2025.
Basic Earnings Per Share – Excluding Items $ 1.94 $ 1.60 $ 4.40 $ 3.76
Third-quarter 2026 operating revenues were $8.8 billion, compared with $7.8 billion for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 13.0%.
